Package hadur117.sepia

Class Gait

java.lang.Object
hadur117.sepia.Gait
public final class Gait extends Object
Sepia's movement: one fixed landing per enemy shot, chosen for how little of it the enemy's aim and our ink leave exposed.

When a shot is read, the gait plays each option forward with the kernel's MovementPredictor, walls included, from where the path already committed to earlier waves ends, until the new wave has passed the body (JET-1, SURF-2). Each option ends in a hit set: the bearings from the wave's source that would meet the body there. The caller rates each by exposure (JET-2, SURF-4) and the gait fixes the least exposed (JET-3). The path then holds that option until the wave has passed, so the landing is known while the wave is in flight and the ink can be laid across it.

Two gaits share the rules. The jet cycle has three options: carry on, turn back, or brake and hold. The ink surf adds both directions at half speed, and lets go of a fixed landing when a bullet learnt of later leaves another under half as exposed (SURF-3). Both orbit the wave's source with the kernel's wall smoothing, hold 450 px or more, and never close range (JET-5); a committed path that would strike a wall or come near the enemy is chosen again (JET-6).

    • shotRead

      public void shotRead(InkWave wave, RobotState now, Point2D.Double enemy, Gait.Rater rater)
      JET-1, SURF-2: a shot has been read. Under the ink surf, an earlier landing is first let go if this new knowledge leaves another of its options under half as exposed (SURF-3); then the new wave's landing is fixed at the least exposed option from where the committed path ends.
      Parameters:
      wave - the new wave
      now - Sepia's state this tick
      enemy - the enemy's last known place
      rater - rates a landing

    • commitJointly

      void commitJointly(InkWave wave, RobotState now, Point2D.Double enemy, Gait.Rater rater)
      SURF-5: the new wave's landing is chosen together with that of the latest wave still in flight, as the pair of options with the least summed exposure. Behind a wave in flight the new wave's own stretch is only the end of its flight, so its landing is mostly set by the option before it; choosing both together gives it the whole flight's reach.

    • letGo

      void letGo(RobotState now, Point2D.Double enemy, Gait.Rater rater)
      SURF-3: for each wave whose landing is fixed and not yet reached, the least exposed of its other options; if that is under LET_GO of the fixed one's exposure, the landing is fixed again from this tick and every later wave's landing is chosen afresh behind it.

    • rescue

      public boolean rescue(RobotState now, Point2D.Double enemy, Gait.Rater rater)
      JET-6: if the committed path would strike a wall or come within ENEMY_CLEARANCE of the enemy in the next LOOKAHEAD ticks, every landing not yet reached is chosen afresh from this tick. At most once every LOOKAHEAD / 2 ticks.
